name: rig-corpus
description: The one Rig corpus. Everything a repository receives is projected from here by rig/lib/project.js; nothing is authored twice.

components.implementation: The implementation skill is also the Rig plugin component that plugin hosts load as skills/rig/SKILL.md. The corpus names that file as its single copy instead of duplicating it.

external_sources.reason: The signed oracle pins these source paths and their bytes (AT-PB-1, AT-PB-3, AT-ADV licence checks). They move to rig/corpus/ in the same change that re-signs those cases; see wiki/specs/close-everything/candidate-amendments/03-central-corpus.md.
